title: Remote viewing Chernobyl three days before it happened

tellings.quote: >> Oh, yeah. Ahead of time. Yeah. Three day three days before it happened.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer, meaning someone trained to perceive distant or hidden events with the mind, says he viewed the 1986 disaster at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Union. According to Buchanan, he saw it three days before it happened, which if true would mean the mind can see into the future.
